description: AI-powered account summarization generates pre-visit briefings and account overviews using cross-object data graphs and configurable prompt templates. Informs sales reps of the latest changes in a provider account since their last interaction.
setup_steps: Enable org permission: ProviderAccountSummarization
Assign permission set: Commercial Admin with Agentforce add-on enabled
Enable cross-object field history tracking on target objects (Setup > Cross-Object Field History Graphs)

Create a cross-object graph: Setup > Feature Settings > Cross-Object Field History Graphs > New Graph > select Account Summarization template or create from scratch
In Graph Properties, enter a label; note the developer name for assignment tasks
Customize graph nodes — add objects with direct or indirect lookup to Account (max 3 levels, up to 5 nodes per level)
Assign graph to org or profile: Admin Console > Account Management > Account Summarization Graph Settings
Optionally customize the autolaunched flow that controls summary generation timing
Optionally customize the prompt template for AI-generated summaries
Schedule batch jobs for bulk summarization processing
prerequisites: Customer Engagement edition with Agentforce add-on SKU installed
Agentforce org permission AgtfreForLifeSciCustEngmt must be enabled (comes with the Agentforce add-on)
Einstein/Agentforce platform features enabled in the org
Prompt Builder and Einstein GPT Platform Add-on licenses assigned
Field history tracking enabled for target fields (formula, text area, and derived fields cannot be tracked)
configuration_details: Cross-object graphs map connected objects and relationships — Account is always the root node
Predefined Account Summarization template provided; can be customized or built from scratch
Graphs can be assigned at org level or per-profile for targeted summarization
Custom prompt templates allow tailoring AI-generated summaries to business needs
Autolaunched flow controls when and how summaries are generated — can be customized
Batch jobs can be scheduled for off-peak bulk summarization across provider accounts
Each component (graph, prompt, flow) can be independently customized per organization needs
objects_and_fields: Any object with direct/indirect lookup to Account can be included in the graph
permissions: Org Permission: ProviderAccountSummarization
Org Permission: AgtfreForLifeSciCustEngmt (from Agentforce add-on)
Permission Set: Commercial Admin (to configure)
User needs Prompt Template Manager permission set
Field-level read access on all summarized fields
batch_jobs: Account Summarization batch job — bulk generates summaries across provider accounts
Configurable scheduling for off-peak execution
gotchas: Account Summarization requires the Agentforce for Customer Engagement add-on SKU — it is NOT available with just the base Commercial Admin permission set
History tracking cannot be enabled for formula, text area, or derived fields
Cross-object graphs support maximum 3 levels of relationships and up to 5 nodes per level
Object must have a direct or indirect lookup to Account to be included in the graph
The feature will not appear in the UI until the Agentforce add-on org permission is enabled
mobile_considerations: Summaries generated server-side; mobile app displays pre-generated summaries
Ensure metadata cache includes summary-related objects for offline access
admin_console_settings: Account Management > Account Summarization Graph Settings
